responsibility: Provides the compiler’s canonical registry of Rust diagnostic error codes and their long-form explanations so the rest of rustc and related tooling can consistently validate, reference, and maintain code assignments. The crate root, `lib.rs`, defines and exports this registry interface as a macro, establishing the authoritative set of active codes while also recording retired ones for maintenance consistency. The `error_codes.rs` root file populates that registry by invoking `register_diagnostics!` with the complete list of active error codes and their associated markdown explanations, and acts as the maintained source of which codes are currently documented, retired, or no longer emitted. Together, the crate gives the compiler a single source of truth for structured error-code documentation and assignment.
